reviews.text: I'm having a lot of fun going to nursery school!
The staff at the shop take such good care of my dog, so it's a place my dog ​​loves!

It's a dog- and owner-friendly place ^_^
The staff are kind and friendly, so you can rest assured knowing they'll be able to hear about your dog's condition.
Rumi-san, thank you very much for visiting us. We will continue to work hard to ensure that both dogs and owners are satisfied! We look forward to your continued support.

We always use the daycare center. They post photos and videos on Instagram every time, and it makes me happy to see how much fun my dog ​​is having. My dog ​​is able to play with other dogs a lot, and I'm pleased that he barks less at other dogs during walks.

I popped in to buy some dog food on short notice.
It was my first time there, but the staff were very friendly and it was clear they love dogs, so I was impressed!
They also seem to offer grooming services, a daycare center, and a hotel, so I think I'll try using them next time!

It's very convenient as it's close to the station. The shop is clean and spacious!

The staff were also very kind and had lovely smiles.

Thank you very much. I'll be back!
The staff were very helpful, and I felt completely at ease leaving my pet with them! I would definitely use this shop again next time!

I won't go into details as I don't see any improvement, but I felt that it wasn't at a sufficient level as a service provider or as a business, even as a place to entrust my precious family. I had high hopes after the change in management, and it's very disappointing because it's conveniently located near the station.
It's a nice shop and the staff are very friendly.
